verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer documents running browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel and collecting the results into structured output, which is a direct bulk operation over many items. Its sandboxed Linux VM, with Python, Node.js and Unix tools, can also process CSV, JSON, Excel and other files, and it can manage tasks across services like GitHub, Jira and Linear. missing for 10: explicit bulk actions on records in connected services (e.g., batch-updating many tickets or emails at once), documented limits on parallelism or batch size, independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel bulk runs.
